items.title: [Sample] Vision sensor family adds on-device inspection presets
items.summary: Sample item. A vision sensor family gains a set of ready-made inspection presets for label presence and cap position. Setup happens on the sensor itself, without a PC. The launch targets packaging lines that change formats often. Talking point: ask how often the customer re-teaches inspections after a changeover.

items.title: [Sample] Regional automation fair, identification demo
items.summary: Sample item. The competitor plans an identification demo at a regional automation fair. Expect RFID read stations and a conveyor tracking cell.

items.title: [Sample] Week in brief: safety software update
items.summary: Sample item. A quiet week. The only release was a configuration software update for safety scanners, adding a simpler zone editor. No new hardware.
